description:
# BadFella Patches v1.0.0

Initial clean release.

- TickTick 8.2.4.0: client Premium gates, reminder/notification compatibility and reduced analytics collection.
- Optional local lists and backups: 299/900 local lists with manual or scheduled local backups. Off by default; cloud ownership and quotas remain unchanged.
- Emby 3.5.72: client unlock and Firebase/DataTransport removal for ARM64 and ARMv7. SDK removal disables Firebase push.

Server entitlements and AI access are unchanged. Keep the same Manager signing key when updating an installed app.
